meta.description: Governed evidence ladder from scaffolded to symbolic_supported to formal_candidate to formal.

ladder.meaning: The theorem statement, assumptions, dependencies, and proof obligations are registered.
Validated symbolic/formal-model evidence supports at least one proof obligation, but proof is not complete.
All obligations are symbolically supported, quantifiers are explicit, equivalence dependencies resolve, and no boundary case remains unclassified.
A proof artifact satisfies all declared formal proof obligations under explicit assumptions.
